install_app: install a WASM applet by name and file path using the host_tool harness
uninstall_app: uninstall a registered WASM applet by name using the host_tool harness
send_request: send an HTTP request with an action and optional payload to a registered URL
register_deregister_service: register or deregister a service URL with timeout and alive time settings
check_response_payload: check if the response payload from the last operation matches an expected JSON dictionary
